integrity: Direct proof and a reproducible standard-library numerical checker. Numerical scans are not used as all-parameter proof. Authorship is not assigned; independent validation has not been conducted.
limitations: The exact two-cycle census is restricted to b=1/2, 1/4<=a<1/2, 0<c<1/2; higher periods and global basins are not classified. The parameter-fold cycle has neutral multiplier one. A later paper could only be inspected in preview and unindexed priority overlap remains possible.
title: A sharp two-cycle fold in the fixed-point-free cosine interval map
